meta.title: GRC / ISMS / NIS2 pricing audit: 136 commercial vendors verified
meta.description: On 17 May 2026 we visited the pricing pages of 136 commercial GRC, ISMS and NIS2 platforms. 103 of them won't tell you what they cost without a demo call. Here's the full list, sortable and filterable. Nine open-source alternatives are excluded by design.

hero.title: We audited 136 commercial GRC/ISMS platforms. 103 won't tell you what they cost.
hero.subtitle: We captured every vendor's pricing page verbatim. Where pricing is hidden behind a demo form we record 'Demo call required'. No estimates, no third-party sources. Nine open-source alternatives (verinice, CISO Assistant, Deming, ISMS Builder, Unicis CE, ourselves and others) are excluded from this list because they don't sell you a subscription.

thesis.title: Why this market is ripe for disruption
thesis.body: 76% of these 136 commercial GRC/ISMS vendors hide their prices. The products are forms, templates and checklists on top of a database. The marginal cost of one more customer is near zero. The price is not. Here are the receipts.

points.title: Five-figure annual contracts for a form
points.body: Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, OneTrust, MetricStream, IBM OpenPages, ServiceNow GRC, Archer, Diligent: every enterprise GRC suite hides pricing and charges €30,000+/year for a workflow tool with templates.

points.title: Eastern EU vendors are 10x cheaper and transparent
points.body: Copla (LT) sells NIS2 for €3,500/year as a dedicated SKU. NIS2 Manager (CZ) at ~€980/month. Conformio (HR) at €145/month. Same product category, different pricing decision.

points.title: OSS competition is growing from Germany and France
points.body: ISMS Builder (DE, AGPL), CISO Assistant (FR, AGPLv3, 130+ frameworks), Little-ISMS-Helper (DACH), Deming (FR): all free self-hosted, all NIS2 explicit.

points.title: Market consolidation is accelerating
points.body: AuditBoard → Optro. CONTECHNET → i-doit. DocSetMinder → Allgeier. 3rdRisk → Diligent. RISMA + Wired Relations + ComplyCloud → Cerivo. StandardFusion → Wolters Kluwer. Galvanize → Diligent. Tugboat → OneTrust. Archer → Cinven.

methodology.title: Methodology
rules: We visited each pricing page manually.
Prices are quoted verbatim from the vendor's website.
No extrapolation from G2, Capterra, third-party blogs or LinkedIn.
Where prices are hidden behind a demo form: 'Demo call required'.
Where prices are only quoted as 'from €X': 'Partial transparency'.
Quarterly re-audit. Vendors can submit corrections.
methodology.correctionsBody: Is our data about your product wrong? Email simon@nisd2.eu with your pricing page URL. We update within 48 hours and keep a change log.

cta.title: Free + Open Source + no lock-in
cta.body: We don't sell NIS2 compliance. We make it accessible. Free, open source, no sales team calling you.
